title: ImplementationContract
description: Frozen implementation contract produced at phase-4i-contract-freeze (TASK-0076). Immutable once issued. Downstream skills validate this before generating code. All hash fields use RFC 8785 canonical form before SHA-256.
x-hash-note: All fields annotated x-hash-algorithm='sha256-rfc8785': (1) serialize source to RFC 8785 JSON Canonical Form (sorted keys, no whitespace, per IETF RFC 8785); (2) UTF-8 encode; (3) SHA-256; (4) lowercase hex. Do NOT use JSON.stringify() without key-sorting.

contract_id.description: UUID v4. Generated at contract freeze time. Immutable.

version.description: Contract version. Starts at 1. Incremented by change-request-handler on each approved change request.

supersedes_contract_id.description: contract_id of the prior version this contract supersedes. Null for version 1.

status.description: active: valid for implementation. superseded: replaced by newer version via approved CR. expired: past 72h expiry. revoked: invalidated by critical failure or manual override.

schema_version.description: Schema version. 1.2.0 adds version, status, sections, expiry, approved_at, supersedes_contract_id, implementation_rules, change_requests fields.

plan_hash.description: SHA-256 of plan_snapshot serialized in RFC 8785 canonical form. Detects plan mutations after freeze.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of module_contracts + interface_contracts object in RFC 8785 canonical form. Detects contract drift.

sections.description: Per-section contract entries. One entry per plan section at freeze time.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of this section's canonical content at freeze time. Allows per-section drift detection.

confidence.description: Section confidence score from phase-4d-confidence-scoring at freeze time.

status.description: Section approval status at freeze time.

open_findings.description: finding_ids of open findings on this section at freeze time. Non-empty only for conditionally_approved sections.

locked_at.description: Timestamp when this section was frozen.

amended_at.description: Timestamp when this section was last amended via an approved change request.

amended_by_cr.description: CR ID that last amended this section.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when validation passed and contract was frozen. Set exclusively by phase-4i-contract-freeze at HITL gate-close — never by caller input.

expiry.description: ISO 8601 datetime: approved_at + 72 hours. After expiry, implementation agents must request contract renewal. Status transitions to 'expired' automatically.

locked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the contract was frozen. Same as approved_at for initial version.

locked_by_phase.description: Phase ID that triggered the freeze. Expected value: 'phase-4i-contract-freeze'.

plan_snapshot.description: Verbatim copy of the consensus_plan (or feature_plan when debate_plan=false) at freeze time. Immutable.

module_contracts.description: Per-module interface contracts frozen at this point.

interface_contracts.description: Cross-module interface contracts (APIs, event schemas, shared types). Optional.

implementation_rules.description: Non-negotiable rules implementation agents must follow. Derived from open critical/high findings, security constraints, and architecture decisions.

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier within this contract.

rule_text.description: The rule as an imperative. E.g. 'All API endpoints MUST validate JWT before processing.'

source.description: Origin: finding_id, decision_id, or descriptive source string.

enforcement.description: hard_block: implementation agent halts if violated. warn: continue with warning. log_only: record and continue.

change_requests.description: Change requests applied to this contract. Maximum 3 per contract (enforced here and in change-request-handler). Each item is a full ChangeRequest object. Use change-request.schema.json for individual CR validation.

decision_log_refs.description: DEC-NNNN IDs of all active DecisionEntry records at freeze time.

mutation_audit.description: Append-only log of every hash recomputation. Supports forensic verification.

public_api.description: All exported functions, classes, and types.

dependencies.description: Module IDs this module depends on. Must form a DAG.

language.description: Primary implementation language for this module.
